content: {"paper_id":"W2067317289","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"nonnegative-matrix-factorization","exact_quote":"Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a useful technique to learn a parts-based representation by decomposing the original data matrix into a basis set and coefficients with non-negative constraints.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以非负矩阵分解为核心方法，将数据矩阵分解为非负基向量与系数，并在此基础上提出类别驱动的 NMF。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"In this paper, we propose a semi-supervised class-driven NMF method to associate a class label with each basis vector by introducing an inhomogeneous representation cost constraint.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确采用半监督设定，用类别标签约束基向量表示，结合监督信息与数据表示学习。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","reason_zh":"摘要只说学习 parts-based representation，未明确低维映射或维度压缩目标，证据不足。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","reason_zh":"摘要只提 NMF 分解，未显式给出低秩约束或低秩近似目标，不能由非负矩阵分解自动推出。"}],"input_issues":[]}
